tx-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its county judge, commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
tx-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Texas's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
tx-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's judge, commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

tx-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City, Town or Village card names the place you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
tx-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Texas's cities, towns and villages has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
tx-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's, town's and village's mayor and council members, or a place's own published list of them.

tx-school-board-members.summary: The three School District cards name the districts you picked, and not the members of their boards of trustees.
tx-school-board-members.why: No list of the trustees of Texas's independent school districts has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
tx-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's trustees, or a district's own published list of its board.
